run.title: Run {{name}}
run.subtitle: On {{computer}}. It opens a new chat and costs what its model calls cost.
run.promptHelp: Given to the run's first agent step.
run.out.started: {{name}} started in a new chat. A question it asks waits there; if nobody has the chat or this page open, it may stop about 5 minutes after it starts waiting.
run.out.picked: You marked this run as the one you started.
run.out.spendCap: A spending limit stopped this run before it began, or the agent's spending-limit file could not be read. Nothing started and nothing was spent.
run.out.notFound: {{name}} is no longer on {{computer}}. Nothing started.
run.out.busy: The agent was busy and did not start it. Nothing started; you can try again.
run.out.refused: It was not started, and nothing was spent.
run.out.notSent: Not sent: nothing started. You can try again.
run.out.unknown: Whether a run of {{name}} started on {{computer}} is not known. It is not sent again from here. After Stop tracking, a new start is a second paid run, and this one may still be running.
run.seen.unchecked: Check again to look for it among the runs.
run.seen.failed: The runs could not be read. Try Check again in a moment.
run.seen.none: No matching run of {{name}} was found yet. It may still have started and not be listed yet; Check again in a moment.
run.seen.some: These runs of {{name}} started around the time you sent it. One of them may be yours; nothing says which.
run.out.error: The answer was an error that does not say whether a run of {{name}} started on {{computer}}. It is not sent again from here. After Stop tracking, a new start is a second paid run, and this one may still be running.
run.out.unread: {{computer}} accepted the start, but its answer could not be read: a run of {{name}} has probably started. It is not sent again from here. After Stop tracking, a new start is a second paid run, and this one may still be running.
run.seen.skipped: Some listed runs could not be read, so one of them may be yours.
run.moved: This page now shows another computer, account or realm. Nothing is sent from here; go back to {{computer}} to see this run.
run.movedIdle: This page now shows another computer, account or realm. Nothing is sent from here.
